message: What happens when I take my Last Breath?
key_facts: You roll with no stat bonus added
On a 10+ you cheat death and remain alive
On a 7-9 Death offers you a bargain to stabilize, or you can refuse and die
On a miss your fate is sealed and you'll die soon

message: What happens on a weak hit with Hack and Slash?
key_facts: You deal your damage to the enemy
The enemy also makes an attack against you

message: When do I use Defy Danger, and what stat do I add?
key_facts: You use it when you act despite an imminent threat or suffer a calamity
The stat you add depends on how you deal with the danger
On a 10+ the threat doesn't come to bear
On a 7-9 the GM offers a worse outcome, hard bargain, or ugly choice

message: How does Volley work on a 7-9?
key_facts: You still deal your damage
You choose one: move into danger, take -1d6 damage, or use up ammo

message: What can I do with hold from Defend?
key_facts: You can redirect an attack from the thing you defend to yourself
You can halve the attack's effect or damage
You can give an ally +1 forward against the attacker
You can deal damage to the attacker equal to your level

message: What do I learn from a strong hit on Discern Realities?
key_facts: You get to ask the GM 3 questions from the list
You take +1 forward when acting on the answers

message: What happens on a hit with Parley?
key_facts: They ask you for something and do it if you make them a promise first
On a 7-9 they need concrete assurance of your promise right now

message: How much HP do I heal when I Make Camp?
key_facts: You consume a ration when you settle in to rest
Waking from at least a few uninterrupted hours of sleep heals half your max HP

message: What's the trigger for Take Watch, and what happens on a miss?
key_facts: It triggers when you're on watch and something approaches the camp
On a miss whatever is approaching has the drop on you

message: How does Undertake a Perilous Journey assign jobs?
key_facts: One party member acts as trailblazer, one as scout, one as quartermaster
A role left unfilled is treated as if it rolled a 6
On a 10+ the quartermaster reduces rations needed by one

message: How do I determine my character's maximum HP?
key_facts: Maximum HP equals your class's base HP plus your Constitution score
You start the game at your maximum HP

message: What stat scores do I assign during character creation?
key_facts: You assign the scores 16, 15, 13, 12, 9, 8 to your stats

message: What modifier do I get for a score of 16 or 17?
key_facts: A score of 16-17 gives a +2 modifier

message: Can my alignment change after character creation?
key_facts: Alignment can change, usually through a gradual shift to a decisive moment
You need a reason for the change that you can explain to the other players

message: What are the five alignments in Dungeon World?
key_facts: The alignments are Good, Lawful, Neutral, Chaotic, and Evil

message: What are the GM's three agenda items?
key_facts: Portray a fantastic world
Fill the characters' lives with adventure
Play to find out what happens

message: What's one of the GM's principles about naming things?
key_facts: Name every person

message: What GM move involves taking away a resource?
key_facts: Use up their resources is one of the GM's moves
GM moves are never spoken as code words, they're things that happen in the fiction

message: What are dungeon moves used for?
key_facts: Dungeon moves are used to make or alter a dungeon on the fly
They're used while mapping out the area being explored

message: When should the GM make a dungeon move during exploration?
key_facts: You can make dungeon moves when the players present an opportunity or miss on a roll
They're well suited for when characters enter a new room or hallway

message: What does the Clumsy armor tag do?
key_facts: Clumsy armor gives -1 ongoing while using it
The Clumsy penalty is cumulative

message: How does armor reduce damage?
key_facts: Armor subtracts its value from the damage taken
If you have more than one item with n Armor, only the highest value counts

message: What does the Forceful weapon tag do?
key_facts: A Forceful weapon can knock someone back a pace, maybe even off their feet

message: What does the Serpent's Tears poison do?
key_facts: Anyone dealing damage against the target rolls twice and takes the better result

message: How much does a warhorse cost, and what's its load?
key_facts: A warhorse costs 400 coins
A warhorse has a load of 12

message: What's the wizard's starting load?
key_facts: The wizard's load is 7 plus their Strength score

message: What gear does a fighter start with?
key_facts: The fighter's load is 12 plus their Strength score
They carry their signature weapon and dungeon rations

message: What does the Backstab discussion say about reducing an enemy's armor?
key_facts: Reducing armor means the enemy loses it until they do something to compensate, like getting a fresh suit or healing up

message: How far away can a target be for a wizard's Fireball and still count as nearby?
key_facts: Nearby depends on context: a few paces in open space, more in an enclosed room

message: Can damage ever take me below 0 HP?
key_facts: Damage can never take a character below 0 HP

message: What happens the moment my HP hits 0?
key_facts: A character reduced to 0 HP immediately takes their Last Breath
No stat is added to the Last Breath roll

message: How much HP do I heal after a day of rest with Recover?
key_facts: After a day of rest you recover all your HP
After three days of rest you remove one debility of your choice

message: How many starting points does a hireling found in a city have?
key_facts: City hirelings start with 6-10 points to distribute

message: What happens to a hireling's loyalty if their cost goes unpaid?
key_facts: If it's been a while since their cost was last paid they get -1 loyalty ongoing until it's met

message: When can I resolve a bond?
key_facts: You may resolve one bond at the end of each session
Resolving a bond lets you mark XP

message: How many spell slots does a 5th-level wizard have?
What's the carrying capacity bonus from a bag of holding?
key_facts: A bag of holding can hold an infinite number of items
A bag of holding always weighs 0, no matter how many items it contains
Retrieving an item requires a roll+WIS, with a 7-9 giving a similar item quickly or the exact item after a delay
